text:
Situation: Dextrose monohydrate has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-01-13 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, a span of 57 months. Stock at Corvale East shows days-on-hand ranging from 2.4 to 13.5 days across seven line items. Corvale General shows 10.1 to 19.5 days across eight line items. Corvale Lakeside shows 3.9 to 19.2 days across four line items. Several items are below a 7-day buffer.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2022-01-13 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. B. Braun's plant received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-10-22, 448 days before the shortage posting, and a subsequent OAI inspection ended 2025-11-21. Baxter plants have multiple OAI inspections: FEI 1025114 with OAI inspections ending 2012-11-16, 2016-02-26, 2024-02-09, and 2024-08-01; FEI 1416980 with OAI inspections ending 2024-08-01 and 2026-04-02; FEI 2618677 with OAI inspections ending 2010-08-26, 2013-04-19, 2014-02-11, 2015-05-01, and 2016-10-03. Hospira's plant (FEI 1021343) had OAI inspections ending 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, with a VAI inspection ending 2019-11-21, 784 days before the shortage posting. Class I recall D-1257-2020 by B. Braun started 2020-04-18, 635 days before posting. Class II recalls by Baxter and B. Braun occurred both before and after the posting, including D-0076-2021 (463 days before), D-0434-2023 (412 days after), D-0543-2023 (426 days after), D-0579-2023 (481 days after), and D-1141-2023 (575 days after).

Our position: Current inventory at multiple sites is below comfortable safety stock for a shortage of this duration. The rule-identified best option is Civica Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses InfoRLife SA as its plant. Four additional suppliers are also not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with Civica Inc. as primary source; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify ICU Medical Inc. as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Arteriocyte Medical Systems, Inc., Becton Dickinson and Company (both entries) for formulary addition; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to allocate existing stock to Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside items below 7 days; requires pharmacy director approval.
5. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage page weekly and report status changes; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative dextrose concentrations or compounding from bulk without a protocol approved by the treating clinicians and the committee.
